stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[3].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

budget_set.statement: set-budget CATEGORY AMOUNT stores a positive monthly budget for the category in the JSON file.

expense_stored.statement: add stores amount, category, date and note as an expense entry in the JSON file.

unknown_category.statement: add with a category that has no budget exits non-zero with an error and leaves the file unchanged.

invalid_amount.statement: add rejects non-numeric, zero, negative, nan, infinite and more-than-2-decimal amounts, and malformed dates, exits non-zero and leaves the file unchanged; set-budget applies the same amount rule.

report_spending.statement: report --month YYYY-MM prints, for every budgeted category, spent, budget and percent used, counting only that month's expenses.

alert_80.statement: A category with spending at or above 80% and below 100% of its budget prints a warning; below 80% prints none.

alert_100.statement: A category with spending at or above 100% of its budget prints an over-budget alert.

single_file.statement: budget_tracker.py is one file importing only standard library modules.
